description: Pierview helps users track and improve their brand's visibility across AI search platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Deepseek, and Grok. Through this app, users can pull mention rate, ranking, and share-of-voice metrics, see which domains and pages are citing their brand, compare visibility and sentiment against competitors, review traffic sent by AI assistants, check technical AI-SEO audit results, read and update their brand kit guidelines, and generate narrated performance reports for any date range.

defaultPrompt: Create a 30 day action plan to improve my visibility based off my data from last month
How does my visibility compare to my competitors?
What content should I create based off the citation data for the last 14 days?
